title: Post-merge S1 scope evaluation rejects the lane's own required lifecycle metadata, making truthful closeout structurally impossible

sha_binding.verified_source_note: This lane's implementation commit and the last non-proof commit on the branch. It carries every source control this bundle describes. It is the anchor only because a file cannot contain its own SHA; post-merge rebinding sets the merge SHA.

scope.diff_stat_note: Measured with git diff origin/main --numstat -- scripts/ at the anchor SHA. The whole-diff total is deliberately not quoted because it would count this proof bundle.

premise_check.claim: The pre-merge file-scope guard already granted the lane's own lifecycle paths unconditionally, while post-merge S1 did not know about them.
premise_check.method: Read ownLaneControlPlanePatterns in scripts/ci/file-scope-guard.ts and evaluateScopeDiff in scripts/ops/truth-check-lib.ts at origin/main.
premise_check.result: Confirmed. The pre-merge guard returned ['.ops/sync/<id>.yml','docs/06_status/lanes/<id>.json','docs/06_status/proof/<id>/**'] since UTV2-1518. evaluateScopeDiff's allowed patterns were [...file_scope_lock, ...expected_proof_paths] only.
premise_check.consequence: The fix is a single shared definition rather than a second copy, which is why ownLaneControlPlanePatterns now delegates to the exported laneLifecycleScopePatterns.

requirements_coverage.exact_lane_only: laneLifecycleScopePatterns keys every pattern to a specific issue ID validated by ISSUE_ID_PATTERN (^UTV2-\d+$). Regressions 1-3.
requirements_coverage.no_directory_exemptions: No 'docs/06_status/lanes/**' and no '.ops/sync/**' is ever produced; asserted directly by the shared-definition test and by mutation Control B.
requirements_coverage.fails_closed_on_bad_id: Regression 8 covers undefined, null, empty, whitespace, 'UTV2-', 'utv2', 'UTV2-1759-extra', '**' and '../../etc'.
requirements_coverage.real_blocked_lane_unblocked: Regression 10 asserts UTV2-1758's actual files_changed and file_scope_lock now pass, and that withholding the grant reproduces the historical failure detail byte-for-byte.
requirements_coverage.one_shared_policy: Asserted by the shared-definition test; ownLaneControlPlanePatterns delegates rather than duplicating.

mutation_testing.method: Both mutants were applied to scripts/ops/truth-check-lib.ts itself and the full suite re-run, then the source was restored. Both are ALSO encoded as executable tests (118, 119) that write a mutant module beside the original, import it, and assert the named regressions flip.

control_b_broad_prefix.why_this_control_matters: The broad-prefix mutant passes every happy-path test while silently admitting every other lane's lifecycle metadata. A happy-path-only suite cannot distinguish it from the real fix.

static_proof.verify_full: PARTIAL - every static stage PASSES; test:live-db refuses locally because ci:assert-staging reports host=127.0.0.1 ref=unidentified expected=xskgrzbteyqdufktjrjx. This lane is T2, touches no DB surface, and changes no runtime behaviour.

r_level.command: pnpm exec tsx scripts/ci/r-level-check.ts --base origin/main --head HEAD

safety_posture.note: Governance tooling only. This lane changes which files S1 accepts as a lane's own lifecycle metadata; it does not change lane execution, delivery, ingestion, grading, or any production path.

known_gaps: The grant is derived from the manifest's own issue_id, not re-derived from the manifest's filename. A manifest whose issue_id disagreed with its filename would grant against the field. That mismatch is already rejected upstream by ops:truth-check M3 and by manifest schema validation, so it is not reachable through the close path.

docs/06_status/proof/<issue>/** is included in the shared patterns and is redundant inside S1, which already exempts the whole docs/06_status/proof/ prefix unconditionally. It is kept so the pre-merge and post-merge callers share one list rather than two subsets. The pre-existing broader S1 proof exemption is deliberately unchanged.

ownLaneControlPlanePatterns (pre-merge) previously used manifest.issue_id verbatim and now goes through laneLifecycleScopePatterns, which uppercases and requires ^UTV2-\d+$. Strictly safer -- a malformed ID now grants nothing -- but a real behaviour change on the pre-merge path. It is a no-op on every manifest that exists: the manifest schema already constrains issue_id to ^UTV2-[0-9]+$ and a sweep of all lane manifests found zero non-canonical IDs. All 46 pre-merge guard tests pass unchanged.

This lane changes S1 only. file_scope_lock freezing, scope-override/v1 resolution, and the audited narrowing path (ops:lane-manifest scope-release, UTV2-1762) are untouched. Widening still requires an external override.
UTV2-1760, UTV2-1761, UTV2-1763 and UTV2-1764 remain recorded and unstaffed. None was folded into this lane.

sign_off.note: This bundle is evidence, not certification. The done-gate is ops:truth-check.
